ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the Year on Year difference in the number of customers from each Cohort in each year
ambiguities.ref:
cohort_year_counts['Prev_Year_Count'] = cohort_year_counts.groupby('First Purchase')['Customer_Count'].shift(1)
    cohort_year_counts['YoY Difference'] = cohort_year_counts['Customer_Count'] - cohort_year_counts['Prev_Year_Count']
ambiguities.intent: Compute adjacent-year customer-count differences within each cohort.
Leave YoY Difference blank when no prior cohort-year exists.
ambiguities.source_text: If there is no prior year value for the cohort-year, `YoY Difference` must be left missing at this stage (and later rendered as blank in the output).
